page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m1.large is an entry-tier virtual server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by the KVM hypervisor. Hardware resources include 2 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon processor running at a nominal clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 2.0 GB of RAM, creating a 1:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation of 1.0 GB per core.

The instance operates without local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system drives and persistent file systems. It integrates baseline network bandwidth rated at 2 Gbps. The instance contains no graphic processing units (GPUs) and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring auxiliary networking resources if external public reachability is required.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:1 compute-to-memory ratio avoids the overhead of unneeded memory capacity when hosting compute-bound jobs with low memory footprints. However, the limited 2.0 GB total RAM acts as an operational bottleneck, excluding memory-heavy database software or large container orchestrations. The server is well aligned with lightweight background services, small web proxies, basic build runners, and simple batch processing routines.
